description: This file defines a configuration class for hosted VLLM chat models, extending OpenAIGPTConfig with additional support for video file handling, parameter mapping, and translation of message contents from file references to video URLs.

classes.name: HostedVLLMChatConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for hosted VLLM chat models, extending OpenAIGPTConfig, supporting custom parameter mapping, video file detection, and message transformation.

methods.name: bool _is_video_file(self, content_item: ChatCompletionFileObject)

methods.name: ChatCompletionVideoObject _convert_file_to_video_url( self, content_item: ChatCompletionFileObject )
methods.description: Converts a file object with file_id or file_data into a ChatCompletionVideoObject with a URL.
